public_rationale: The available figures do not establish a comparable industry share. These are material checks on the estimate, but combining them would mix periods and definitions. No defensible calculation establishes either side of the 50% threshold.
limitations: The author supplied neither a period nor an industry accounting method.
Annualized figures cannot substitute for realized quarterly revenue.
The available counterevidence is contextual rather than a matched denominator.

from_speaker: entire revenue of the generative AI industry
our_interpretation: 'By my estimates' describes the evidentiary basis, not a conditional antecedent.
Read revenue as sales earned during a common period, not financing, valuation, or annualized revenue run rate.
Use April–June 2025, the latest completed quarter before publication, because no measurement period is specified.
Include generative AI products and services sold by hyperscalers. The treatment of infrastructure suppliers, hardware, and transactions between industry participants must be explicit.
The numerical test is combined OpenAI and Anthropic revenue divided by consistently defined total industry revenue, strictly greater than 50%.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable-period estimates on a consistent revenue basis establish a combined share above 50%, including hyperscaler generative AI revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable-period estimates establish a combined share of 50% or less, or a reliable lower bound for other industry revenue equals or exceeds the two companies' combined revenue.
